solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Noted part-player on stage

parts.note: reads like a famous actor, but 'noted' means sung in musical notes and the part is a role in a staged musical drama

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sings a role in a staged musical drama is a performer of noted parts in the lyric theatre.

clue.text: An ode required for author getting married

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, the American writer

explanation.surface: Someone getting married needs a writer to compose an ode for the occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a kind of lyric verse composition, one example of the general term.

clue.text: Skinhead breaks rules, drops out

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the other, splitting it apart and sitting inside

parts.note: to rule is to reign, so rules gives reigns
the head, or first letter, of skin is S

explanation.surface: A skinhead who ignores the rules leaves society behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skinhead' looks like a thug but is read as the head of the word skin.
explanation.definitionFit: To give up a post or quit is to step down, so dropping out is a looser synonym.

clue.text: Kind holy man has a heart of gold

indicators.note: the holy man holds the next piece at his centre, so it sits inside him

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A kind-hearted holy man is said to have a heart of gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind and sort are both nouns meaning a type or category.

clue.text: Retribution seems in fashion

indicators.note: to fashion something is to shape it, so these letters are reshaped into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Getting your own back seems to be the trend nowadays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in fashion' reads as trendy, but 'in' is fodder and 'fashion' the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis is the Greek goddess of vengeance, and her name stands for deserved punishment.

clue.text: Long times in the onslaught

indicators.note: the run of letters sits inside the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: An attack that seems to go on for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Aeons, also spelt without the A, are immensely long periods of time.

clue.text: Teacher on form in advanced seminar

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: a schoolmaster is a teacher
a form is a school class

explanation.surface: A teacher on good form running a high-level seminar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Form' is a British school class or year group.
explanation.definitionFit: A session where an expert teaches advanced pupils is an advanced seminar.

clue.text: A tape recording?

parts.note: suggests a cassette or audio tape, but the tape is a tape measure and the recording is noting a size

explanation.definitionFit: Recording a length with a tape measure gives a size, a figure taken with a ruler-like tool.

clue.text: They stay well away from work

definitions.text: They stay well away from work

parts.words: They stay well away from work
parts.note: seems to mean people who keep their distance, but 'well' hints at people who are healthy yet feign illness to skip work

explanation.definitionFit: Shirkers who pretend to be ill avoid their jobs while actually being fit.

clue.text: It may be taken as an indication of health

definitions.text: It may be taken as an indication of health

parts.words: It may be taken as an indication of health
parts.note: a doctor takes a reading with a thermometer, and the result shows whether a patient has a fever

explanation.definitionFit: Body heat measured with a thermometer is a standard sign of fever or wellness.

clue.text: Ably matched, perhaps, in ambitious Shakespearean role

indicators.note: signals that these letters might be arranged differently to give the answer

explanation.surface: An actress well matched to playing a scheming Shakespearean character.
explanation.definitionFit: The scheming wife in the Scottish play goads her husband to murder for the crown.

clue.text: He fell out of sympathy with his partner

definitions.text: He fell out of sympathy with his partner

parts.words: He fell out of sympathy with his partner
parts.note: reads as a quarrel, but recalls the biblical first man who fell from grace by eating the fruit Eve offered him

explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the first man shared in Eve's sin, causing the Fall of humankind.

clue.text: Go down with a bristle

parts.note: the sun sets when it goes down

explanation.surface: Getting down with a bristling feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology a seta is a stiff hair or bristle, as on a worm.

clue.text: Dire disaster — trapped by high-explosive missile

indicators.note: one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: TNT is a well-known high explosive

indicators.note: a disaster leaves things in chaos, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A dire catastrophe as something is caught up in a blast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high-explosive' looks like a description of the missile, but it is the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Trident is the submarine-launched nuclear missile system used by Britain and the US.

clue.text: Multiple occasions

definitions.meaning: in arithmetic a multiplied amount, as in three of something
instances or moments when something happens

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both multiplied by and a number of instances.

clue.text: Money that's not well-earned

parts.note: seems to mean undeserved pay, but means money received while not well, that is ill

explanation.definitionFit: Payment received from an employer while off work through illness.

clue.text: Type of brush undergrowth

indicators.note: suggests a variety, so the letters take a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Asking what variety of brush the undergrowth is.
explanation.definitionFit: A bush is woody undergrowth, a low plant with many stems.

clue.text: Sounds of relief of audible dimensions

indicators.note: what is heard, not written, tells us the word is said out loud

parts.note: dimensions are measurements, giving size

explanation.surface: Relieved noises that can be heard all around.
explanation.definitionFit: Long exhalations made when something worrying has passed are sounds of relief.

clue.text: Scraps enjoyed by students

definitions.meaning: British student fundraising weeks and pranks, called rag weeks

explanation.walkthrough: A rag is a British student charity event full of stunts.
explanation.definitionFit: Torn cloth scraps and student charity carnivals share the same word.

clue.text: Marian has a song in her heart

indicators.note: the letters are found at the centre of the name

explanation.surface: Marian has a happy tune going round inside her.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is an operatic song for a solo voice.

clue.text: An animal or bird that runs from left to right

parts.note: the emu is a flightless Australian bird that runs fast

explanation.surface: Something that moves across the field from one side to another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from left to right' sounds like direction, but places the running bird between L and R.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemur is a primate from Madagascar, an animal.

clue.text: He gets what's left

parts.note: reads like someone taking leftovers, but what's left is what a will bequeaths

explanation.definitionFit: A beneficiary under a will receives what the dead person bequeathed.

clue.text: Idle chatter has teeth on edge

indicators.note: idle chatter is loose talk, so the letters are loosened and rearranged

explanation.surface: Pointless gossip sets someone's nerves jangling.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes the thing: a toothed wheel that allows motion in one direction only.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratchet is a mechanism whose wheel or bar has teeth cut along its edge.

clue.text: Trees providing large bows

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing
a bow is a curve, so bows gives arches

explanation.surface: Trees with large branches bending over.
explanation.definitionFit: Larches are deciduous conifers, a kind of tree.

clue.text: Home fixture for City, but to be arranged

parts.note: Bath is a city in the west of England

indicators.note: an arrangement puts things into a new order

explanation.surface: A home match for City, but the date is yet to be arranged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Home fixture' reads as a football game; it is something fixed in a house. BATH is an English city; BUT rearranged gives TUB.
explanation.definitionFit: A tub to wash in is a fitted item in a house's bathroom.

clue.text: One among the lesser folk in history

definitions.text: One among the lesser folk in history

indicators.note: the letters sit among the words that follow, spanning them

explanation.surface: A peasant counted among the lowly people of the past.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: a medieval bondsman, one of the lowest class in history.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval peasant bound to his lord's land was among the lowest people in feudal society.

clue.text: Left in charge but desert one's post

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a charge or price is a fee

explanation.surface: Someone left in charge who abandons the post.
explanation.definitionFit: To run away is to abandon a position, as a sentry who deserts.

clue.text: Settles in the country in France

definitions.meaning: the French word for country or land

explanation.definitionFit: The English verb means to settle up, and the French noun means a country.

clue.text: Determination needed by chickens

definitions.meaning: small stones swallowed by fowl to help grind food

explanation.definitionFit: Courage and resolve, and the gravel poultry swallow to aid digestion, share the word.

clue.text: Rising flavour has bite

indicators.note: in a down clue the word reads upwards, so its letters run backwards

parts.note: a tang is a sharp flavour

explanation.surface: A rising flavour that has a sharp bite to it.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition describes the insect: a small fly whose bite irritates.

clue.text: Slam the coin frantically into it!

definitions.text: Slam the coin frantically into it!

indicators.note: a frantic action is wild and disordered, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: A frustrated gambler bangs money into the machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambling machine operated by inserting coins into a slot.

clue.text: Call for scene-shifting? It's tea break!

indicators.note: scene-shifting moves things about, so the letters are moved into a new order
breaking up the phrase scatters its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Stagehands say moving scenery demands a tea break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifting' turns SCENE into NECES and 'break' turns ITSTEA into SITATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To call for something is to demand or require it, making it needed.
